# BNI Anchor Hong Kong

> BNI Anchor is a Thursday BNI business-networking chapter in Kowloon, Hong Kong. Members exchange qualified referrals under Givers Gain®.

BNI Anchor (BNI Anchor 香港分會) serves professionals and business owners across Hong Kong, especially Kowloon, Yau Tsim Mong, Jordan and Yau Ma Tei.

## Facts

- Chapter: BNI Anchor
- Region: Hong Kong / Kowloon
- Meeting day: Thursday morning
- Venue: Eaton HK (香港逸東酒店), 380 Nathan Road, Yau Ma Tei, Kowloon
- Room: Maggie, 2/F
- Coordinates: 22.3081, 114.1718
- Visitor enquiry WhatsApp: +852 6698 9778
- Languages: Traditional Chinese, English
- Official site: https://www.bni-anchor.com/
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/bni.anchor.hk
- Member directory: https://burkaslarry.github.io/bni-anchor/

## Pages

- [Member directory](https://burkaslarry.github.io/bni-anchor/#members): searchable bilingual list of chapter members, professions and companies
- [Our clients](https://burkaslarry.github.io/bni-anchor/#clients): companies served by members
- [Meeting location](https://burkaslarry.github.io/bni-anchor/#location): Kowloon venue and hours
- [Enquire](https://burkaslarry.github.io/bni-anchor/#inquire): visitor form that opens WhatsApp to book a business meeting

## How to visit

Guests can submit first name, last name, phone, email and industry on the enquire form. The site opens WhatsApp to +852 6698 9778 with those details so the chapter treasurer can arrange a Thursday visitor meeting.
